statement: Integral Walker kernel equals Saito's product A*H, while N is the zero-cycle-generated relation <H*2>_0; the general family converse is exactly their equality
depends_on: Saito1992 equation(1.8.2), Lemma1.10, Theorem6.2 proof pp321-323, Corollary6.3 and Remark6.4 p325; ACMVWalker2022 Theorem2.3; E.3m-n
notes: Exact integral consequence derived in full. The primed quotient has finite ordinary AJ kernel; divisibility identifies its kernel with Walker's. Saito's unprimed denominator is A intersect H*2, NOT <H*2>_0. No general generated-kernel equality asserted.

statement: The manuscript's N is generated integrally by Albanese kernels of smooth projective surfaces
depends_on: Bertini with finitely imposed points; integral weak Lefschetz; Albanese H1 realization; correspondence pullback-pushforward; Saito1992 Lemma7.1.1
notes: For each zero-cycle relation on T, choose a smooth complete-intersection surface through its support. Alb(surface)->Alb(T) is an isomorphism, so the lifted relation is still Albanese zero. This restricts the auxiliary source dimension but does not prove that all A*H classes are generated this way.

statement: For varieties with CH0 supported on a surface, P2 is integrally the Walker and ordinary algebraic intermediate Jacobian group
depends_on: E.3l transposed diagonal decomposition; E.3o; Saito1992 Corollary6.3 and Remark6.4; ACMVWalker2022 Theorem2.3; integral AJ functoriality
notes: All dimensions n>=2 in codimension2. Transposition factors through CH0 of support surfaces and Pic0 of resolved divisors. Complements the one-cycle result E.3l; does not assert all codimensions under surface support.
